Browser pane view, overlay slot, controls, address input, navigation/history/zoom and tab URL/label policies, pane chrome CSS, guest recovery/focus, and viewport management. BrowserWebviewPort isolates the feature from Electron ambient types; Desktop adapts the real guest, persistent registry, download state, and IPC.

Terminal pane view와 host 계약, renderer engine(pane manager, fit/scroll/WebGL/output scheduler), theme/style, search UI, terminal domain 및 agent/title 정책, input queue와 selection copy. Desktop은 PTY IPC/process ownership을 유지하고 app adapter를 제공한다. Agent status와 runtime title store는 React에 의존하지 않는 Zustand vanilla 상태를 사용해 Main에서도 terminal agent 정책을 가져올 수 있다. Renderer는 React useStore로 구독한다.
Shared renderer UI primitives with injected host capabilities: Popover, ContextMenu, and accessible MenuList. Desktop supplies interaction coordination and product icons through adapters.
